inputs.text: This is how the system protects its own: the Punjab and Haryana High Court says pre-arrest bail can be revoked only with clear proof of misuse or changed circumstances, even though the stolen articles remain missing and the allegations are serious. Justice Sumeet Goel dismissed the cancellation plea, leaving the accused shielded while the public is told to produce proof that may be out of sight. Calling that a safeguard obscures what it does: turns strict rules into cover for keeping accountability just beyond reach.
